title: Rethinking Scientific Discovery in the Agentic Era
abstract: arXiv:2607.03863v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced scientific discovery, but most AI4Science systems remain fragmented tools that rely on humans to coordinate problem formulation, literature grounding, model use, simulation, validation, and knowledge reuse. This paper presents \textbf{SCION (Scientific Collaborative Innovation with Agentic Organizational Nexus)}, an agentic scientific operating system that acts as an \textbf{organizational nexus}. Through a Science Agent serving as a \textbf{Meta-Harness}, SCION connects scientific tasks, tools, agents, artifacts, and memory, transforming research into an executable, auditable, and reusable operational process. At its core is the \textbf{Research Execution Plan (REP)}, which compiles high-level scientific intent into staged objectives, dependencies, verification checkpoints, tool requirements, expected artifacts, and fallback conditions. translated_title: 重新思考智能体时代的科学发现
translated_abstract: 人工智能已经推动了科学发现，但大多数AI4Science系统仍然是碎片化的工具，依赖人类来协调问题构建、文献梳理、模型使用、仿真模拟、验证和知识复用等环节。本文提出了SCION（基于智能体组织枢纽的科学协作创新），一个作为“组织枢纽”的智能体科学操作系统。通过一个充当“元管理框架”的科学智能体，SCION连接科学任务、工具、智能体、研究成果和记忆，将科研转化为可执行、可审计、可复用的运行流程。其核心是“研究执行计划”（REP），它将高层次的科学意图编译为分阶段目标、依赖关系、验证检查点、工具需求、预期成果和回退条件。SCION进一步集成了分层多智能体执行机制……
tldr: 提出了SCION——一个作为组织枢纽的智能体科学操作系统，通过研究执行计划（REP）和元管理框架将碎片化的AI4Science工具整合为可执行、可审计、可复用的完整科研流程。
en_tdlr: SCION is an agentic scientific operating system that acts as an organizational nexus, transforming fragmented AI4Science tools into executable, auditable, and reusable research processes through its Research Execution Plan (REP) and Meta-Harness architecture.
